response_texts: Good, you are finally here. Khajiit was getting tired of waiting. Can you help this one carry the chick to his cart?
Damn it, step away from the brat! I'll cleave you skull in two if you don't!
So loud, as always. But it is the chick's head that will be crushed if you do not stop right there, yes?
Oblivion take you, you vile Daedra spawn...
Friend, come closer. Let us talk business with kind Ja'zel, hmm?
Come on, stop fooling around and wipe that smirk off your face. This isn't the time to read this.
What? But this is just a white rabbit... And it's dead...
Bah, that's not it. Nothing but rumors again.
Something feels wrong, though... I smell something sweet, like it's mixed with blood... Is this wine?
Ja'zel, how's the battle going?
The airship has just dealt with the cockatrice. Now all that is left is the barrier at the entrance to the temple, yes?
But it is a strong barrier, so we are at a stalemate now, see? No worries, though. It will soon crack.
Even if it cracks, the barrier can be renewed, right? Is there any chance that the barrier splits our troops apart?
Ah, do not worry. A barrier of this scale would take months to renew and they will be in no shape to start repairing it after so many attacks, no? They are merely stalling us.
As soon as the barrier cracks, the first group will rush in together with the Dwemer automatons from Eton Nir Tech. You should join them, yes?
Aren't you a little overconfident? No matter how many people we have, there's a horde of those Reachmen!
Ah, but that is not all. In addition to Hircine worshippers, even a squad of old orcish soldiers joined the witch's forces, yes?
They will be tough opponents. Unless we are careful, we will be the ones being hunted, no? Ja'zel wishes to take all possible precautions to prevent that.
No one will take these children away... no one... no one...
It's the influence of the heart stone... It drove her mad. She doesn't even notice us.
So what do we do with this woman?
We leave her alone. Her heart is broken and she's as good as dead.
We'll just take the heart stone and then return. Call the airship.
I understand. Hello, professor, is that you? We are done here! Please come get us with the airship!
1, 2, 3, 4, 5. There are five chicks. But the letter said there should be six, no?
Oh, you know. We had a werewolf incident a while ago. I guess one of the chicks ran away then.
A werewolf... If you say so, then it must be so. Ja'zel can balance accounts for the missing chick.
Well, let us leave this for now...
Oh? Is there a problem?
You should try to be a little nicer, no? This one only comes because your jarl calls him.
Sorry, but I was not ordered to be nice.
Is that all? You've already finished your duty here. Get lost.
Oh, do not say that. The civil war is still being felt. You and Ja'zel will meet again whether you like it or not. Be nice.
No. Why in Oblivion did the jarl even call for you? This is insane!
Do not say such bad things about your master. Leaders always have their plans, yes?
You are despicable. We're done talking!
Oh, this one is getting so very scared! Well, let us leave, then. The chicks are also scared.
But remember something, yes? Ja'zel decided to collect six chicks and he will surely do so. This is a cat's promise.
Pfft...
Is it over, Mr. Chick Trader? Then I'd like to process the meat before it spoils.
It is over now, yes. You can do whatever you want with it.
Cat and bear meat today... Could you bring some baby goat next time? That was delicious.
Ja'zel's main business got busy again, so this side work will be stopped for a while. You should find a new supplier, perhaps.
That is a pity. A real pity...
I can't believe you managed to hunt down that beast. Looks like the Owl is going to have his hands full with you...
To sleep, to dream of Tamriel... Unsullied by Anui-El. Man-ape, tell us... Maruhk, guide us...
A poem of the Alessian Order... We have reached deep. Molag Bal plays a strange game... Or was there something else, perhaps...?
Please, stop... Khajiit does not wish to see this... no more...
You still returned, no? But it seems you have reached your limit. Oh, Khajiit's guest is here! So this one will stop wasting time with you.
Nobody came back... Is the witch's curse real? They told me I'd be okay if I got baptized...
But a bad boy can't get baptized... Ja'zel said so.
I'm scared... I don't want to be baptized and grow up. I'd rather be a chick forever than become such a monster...
It will be okay. Surely... It will work. I'll be with you.
Well done, hunter. But the Great Hunt is not over, for Hircine's hunger is never satisfied.
Come, let us continue the hunt. Let's get drunk on blood together.
Whaaaat? Why is there another me?! Martin, my dear, do your job properly!
My adorable charm and your handsome self can coexist just fine. Twice the benefit! Where's the harm in that?
Oh no, no, no, Uncle Sheogorath wants to hog the spotlight all to himself! Can't you understand this delicate maiden's heart?
If you truly had a maiden's heart, you'd be swooning over how cute I am! Look, look! Purrr, meow!
On a second look... What an adorable little kitty! I thought you were an ugly elf cousin first because of your long, pointy ears!
Oh, don't tell me that this handsome man is losing his vision! Don't throw a fit at me like that chap whose boyfriend just died!
Hah! That Pelinal made me laugh the hardest at the time. He cut off your head and kicked it high in the sky!
The cheese that spilled from my neck made Huna's rainbow bridge all sticky. He was so frustrated, hahaha!
The Ashkhan, Gadaratto. He's the leader of the Ashlanders. There's a rumor going around that he's the Nerevarine's child due to his strength.
Nerevarine had children? Could the rumors be true?
That rumor is nothing but a rumor, Ozwald. Most likely it's just a valuable lie used to bring the Ashlanders of Ebonwall together.
Probably. But his strength is likely real, considering Ashkhans are recognized warriors. We should avoid fighting him if possible.
This is the commander of the volunteer army, Magni the Iron Fist. They say he killed a giant when he was still young... He's also known for never taking captives.
Looks like Stendarr's teachings didn't enter this Nord's head. I can see his weakness through his impulsive and unpredictable approach.
You should avoid fighting the Nord army. Thanks to the slaughter in Ebonwall, I don't think they'll be feeling very merciful to anyone.
I know. We're focusing only on the witch.
Get off the airship immediately! It's going to explode!
You shouldn't have come here... I'm afraid you've been deceived.
You're back again... Even if you can't remember, you should have known by instinct by now.
How many times do we have to repeat the same ending before you're satisfied? If you keep doing this, your fateline will be anchored.
He's not your friend. He's not that kind. He just wants a secret to remain a secret.
Listen to me. He is not your ally. What he wants for you cannot save you.
If he comes here, I can't help you. So get out of here quickly, before he arrives.
It will be a long night...
Your dreams will be full of hunger and thirst...
My words will fork as lightning and show you the righteousness of darkness...
Even Zuzu could not foresee your fate. This is why the cursed ones are watching you.
The secrets of Hamah and her bloodline must be kept. You do not deserve to know the truth. I am sorry, but you must sleep here.
This person is either that Sacred Anatomancer leading the Holy Pipers or a madman, judging by his strange... headgear.
Tell us about this crazy bastard's background. What kind of life has this man lived?
That's precisely the problem... I've been researching his life, but all I could find about him is completely incoherent.
Maybe that's related to the Oneiromancer? Was she withholding information about the Anatomancer, too?
No, I don't think so. I suspect there are other forces at work here... Every time I read something about him, the contents change.
The first time I've read the documents, it said he was a Nord, but the next time he was suddenly a Breton... and now he's an Imperial.
He was supposed to be the one who organized the Holy Pipers, but now it says that they summoned him... And the documents keep rewriting themselves like that, more and more...
What do you mean? Is this some kind of a curse? From how disgusting it sounds, I'd say it's related to Daedra...
I don't understand it, either. And what's even worse, this Piper's Hill we're heading to appeared quite suddenly... only a few years ago.
This Anatomancer is not someone we should be approaching. Now I've got a bad feeling about all of this.
Ah, Talos... cannibal, waste of human life, demon of Alcaire... Such a repugnant name. Yet even so, Ja'zel cannot help but admire the sound of it.
A great criminal who drenched the world in blood, crushing even his friends who admired him, even his lover and children, all for his own ambition.
Ja'zel envies him, ah, he envies him so much... Not for his stale fame, but for his bronze flesh and blood without a shred of conscience.
This is the way to Heaven, Ja'zel believes. So come, my precious Chick... Let us fall into Heaven together.
